# Independent Part 4D truth

Inputs were read from unchanged INFY standalone and YESBANK consolidated retained HTML.
Expected findings are separately authored literals, never generated by the production evaluator.
CFO is source-reported Cash from Operating Activity, in INR crore, not free cash flow.

Deposit deceleration was derived before rule implementation from FY2023=217382,
FY2024=266230, FY2025=284420:
(18190/266230 - 48848/217382)*100
= (18190*217382 - 48848*266230)*100/(266230*217382)
= -45253122300/2893680493 percentage points (reduced).
Independent long division at 50 significant digits gives the literal in expected_findings.json.
No subtraction of rounded displays is permitted. Exact fractions use no tolerance.
CFO/PAT is exactly 29409/25568; all other numerical expectations reuse locked Part 4C truth.
Directional expected findings are authored from literal comparisons of the four source inputs.
